# Kubernetes documentation

- Upstream: https://github.com/kubernetes/website, branch `main`
- Commit: `e136b827da7537cdf5ec2a497335e6b42962a3a6`
- Copied on 2026-11-07
- Source paths for grimoire: `vendor/kubernetes/content/en` (English), `vendor/kubernetes/content/de`

## What was copied

The Markdown files below `content/en` and `content/de`, and the repository's `LICENSE`. Left out:
images, other binaries, the other languages, Hugo layouts, data files and everything outside these
two folders. The German pages were added on 2026-11-07 from the same commit.
The Markdown is unchanged; Hugo shortcodes such as `{{< note >}}` stay as text.
